arXiv:2606.03899v1 [cs.LG] 2026 年 6 月 2 日arXiv:2606.03899v1 [cs.LG] 02 Jun 2026

先去噪，后正交：通过光谱滤波了解 μ 子的动量Denoise First, Orthogonalize Later: Understanding Momentum in Muon via Spectral Filtering

Xianliang Li Equal contribution. The Institute of Statistical Mathematics The Graduate Institute for Advanced Studies, SOKENDAI Zihan Zhang11footnotemark: 1 National Institute of Informatics The Graduate Institute for Advanced Studies, SOKENDAI Weiyang Liu The Chinese University of Hong Kong Han Bao Corresponding author. The Institute of Statistical Mathematics The Graduate Institute for Advanced Studies, SOKENDAI Tohoku University RIKEN AIP
摘要Abstract

Muon 最近在大型语言模型训练中表现出了强大的实证性能，但动量在 Muon 中的理论作用仍不清楚。现有的 Mu 分析要么消除了孤立研究光谱更新的动力，要么保留了动力而不解释为什么它提高了经验性能。我们的工作通过展示 Muon 作为光谱滤波器的动量来弥补这一差距。在结构化信号加扰动梯度模型下，我们证明动量在保留主导信号的同时抑制扰动，从而扩大了它们之间的光谱间隙。这种扩大的间隙稳定了传递到 Muon 正交化步骤的矩阵的奇异子空间，从而使更新结果更加可靠。我们进一步表明，在正交化之前应用动量可以实现Muon has recently demonstrated strong empirical performance in large language model training, but the theoretical role of momentum in Muon remains unclear. Existing analyses of Muon either remove momentum to study spectral updates in isolation, or retain momentum without explaining why it improves empirical performance. Our work bridges this gap by showing momentum in Muon acts as a spectral filter. Under a structured signal-plus-perturbation gradient model, we prove that momentum suppresses perturbations while preserving the dominant signal, thereby enlarging the spectral gap between them. This enlarged gap stabilizes the singular subspaces of the matrix passed to Muon’s orthogonalization step, making the resulting update more reliable. We further show that applying momentum before orthogonalization achieves事实证明更强provably stronger与梯度的信号分量对齐，而不是颠倒该顺序或简单地消除动量。包括法学硕士预训练在内的各种任务的实验支持了我们的理论分析。更广泛地说，我们的理论为理解其他基于矩阵的优化器中动量的好处提供了一个起点。alignment with the signal component of the gradient than either reversing this order or simply removing momentum. Experiments across diverse tasks, including LLM pretraining, support our theoretical analysis. More broadly, our theory offers a starting point for understanding the benefits of momentum in other matrix-based optimizers.

项目页面：Project page:yinleung.com/denoise-ortho

1 简介Introduction

现代神经网络，尤其是大型语言模型 (LLM)，通常由数十亿个参数组成，需要大量计算资源进行训练。随着模型规模的不断增长，优化器设计对于高效的大规模学习变得越来越重要。在 LLM 训练中，自适应一阶坐标方法，例如 AdamModern neural networks, especially large language models (LLMs), typically consist of billions of parameters and require substantial computational resources for training. As the model scale continues to grow, optimizer design has become increasingly important for efficient large-scale learning. In LLM training, adaptive first-order, coordinate-wise methods such as Adam[26]和亚当Wand AdamW[32]仍然是事实上的选择。最近，基于矩阵的优化器，例如 Shampooremain the de facto choice. More recently, matrix-based optimizers such as Shampoo[20],肥皂, SOAP[56]，和接穗, and Scion[37]作为在梯度更新中利用矩阵结构的替代方案，人们越来越感兴趣。在这些优化器中，Muonhave received growing interest as alternatives that exploit matrix structure in gradient updates. Among these optimizers, Muon[24]，它使用牛顿-舒尔茨迭代近似正交动量矩阵，在 LLM 预训练中显示出有希望的经验性能, which approximately orthogonalizes the momentum matrix using a Newton–Schulz iteration, has shown promising empirical performance in LLM pretraining[30]，并且最近的优化器基准测试进一步确定 Muon 以及更广泛的基于矩阵的方法是 AdamW 的强大替代方案, and recent optimizer benchmarks further identify Muon, along with matrix-based methods more broadly, as a strong alternative to AdamW[44, 60].

优化器设计中第二个长期存在的主题是动量的作用。经典分析建立了平滑和强凸问题的动量加速率A second long-standing thread in optimizer design is the role of momentum. Classical analyses establish accelerated rates for momentum on smooth and strongly convex problems[38, 35, 51]. Cutkosky and Mehta [11]证明动量消除了标准化 SGD 中对大批量的需求，这是 Muon 极坐标更新的矢量侧模拟，两者都只保留梯度方向。然而，深度学习的实际情况更加微妙。prove that momentum eliminates the need for large batches in normalized SGD, which is the vector-side analog of Muon’s polar update in the sense that both retain only the direction of the gradient. The practical picture in deep learning is, however, more nuanced.Wang et al. [57]研究表明，在小学习率和高梯度噪声的情况下，动量仅提供边际效益，这表明其可证明的加速位于确定性（或大学习率）状态，而不是随机噪声降低本身。更多最近的工作show that at small learning rates and high gradient noise, momentum offers only marginal benefit, suggesting that its provable acceleration sits in the deterministic (or large-learning-rate) regime rather than in stochastic noise reduction per se. More recent work[29]将频域中的动量重新构造为梯度流上的低通滤波器，表明相关机制可能是滤波而不是加速。尽管取得了这些进展，但 Muon 强大的实证表现和动量在其内部所扮演的角色都还没有得到很好的理解。reframes momentum in the frequency domain as a low-pass filter on the gradient stream, suggesting that the relevant mechanism may be filtering rather than acceleration. Despite these developments, neither Muon’s strong empirical performance nor the role momentum plays inside it is well understood.

On the whole, theory tells us that heavy momentum brings no benefit — and may even degrade convergence — inside Muon, but this obviously contradicts what we observe in practice.

Muon的极地更新和动量之间的关系更为微妙。 而正交-SGDMThe relationship between Muon’s polar update and momentum is more nuanced. Whereas Orthogonal-SGDM[53]，在 Muon 之前提出，正交化每个每步梯度, proposed prior to Muon, orthogonalizes each per-step gradient之前before动量平滑，Muon 应用极坐标更新momentum smoothing, Muon applies the polar update之后after动量平滑，显着优于尤其是在语言模型预训练方面momentum smoothing, significantly outperforming particularly on language model pretraining[24]。 因此，Muon 的成功鼓励我们仔细研究（i）为什么动量平滑实际上很重要，以及（ii）为什么极性因子应该放在动量平滑之后。 为此，我们比较了三种 Muon 管道的权重更新. Therefore, Muon’s success encourages us to closely look at (i) why momentum smoothing matters practically, and (ii) why the polar factor should be put after momentum smoothing. 极地前更新Pre-polar updateequation˜1是标准的 Muon 更新is the standard Muon update[24]。极地后更新. Post-polar updateequation˜2形式化正交-SGDM 变体。仅 Polar 更新formalizes the Orthogonal-SGDM variant. Polar-only updateequation˜3完全消除动量作为无动量基线。removes momentum entirely as a no-momentum baseline.Figure˜1显示在整个训练过程中，前极地主导了后极地和仅极地训练。 以下是两个结论。 首先，前极性和后极性管道以相反的顺序使用相同的两个运算，因此它们之间的任何间隙必定来自顺序本身，因为动量和正交化不会像数值运算一样交换。其次，从前极区到仅极区的差距表明，动量所发挥的作用是正交化本身无法实现的：动量是 Muon 的重要组成部分，而不是表面上的加速技巧。 这就提出了我们感兴趣的核心问题：shows that Pre-polar dominates both Post-polar and Polar-only throughout training. Two conclusions follow. First, Pre-polar and Post-polar pipelines use the same two operations in opposite orders, so any gap between them must come from the ordering itself, because momentum and orthogonalization do not commute as numerical operations. Second, the gap from Pre-polar to Polar-only shows that momentum plays a role that orthogonalization alone cannot fulfill: momentum is an essential component of Muon, not a cosmetic acceleration trick. This raises the central question of our interest:

动量在梯度流中起什么作用？为什么将其放在正交化之前在 Muon 内部很重要？What role does momentum play on the gradient stream, and why does placing it before orthogonalization matter inside Muon?

本文弥补了μ子理论所缺失的谜题。动量首先充当梯度流上的光谱滤波器。在μ介子内部，这种过滤必须在正交化之前发生。极坐标因子保留奇异方向，但将所有奇异值替换为奇异值，因此当它直接作用于噪声梯度时，它会消除信号和噪声方向之间的幅度差距，即使经过后续动量，我们也永远无法区分信号和噪声。当动量首先起作用时，它会过滤梯度流以保留持续信号分量并减弱扰动，因此极坐标因子在其奇异值结构已经将信号与噪声分开的矩阵上运行。指导原则很简单：This paper supplies the missing puzzle of Muon theory. Momentum first acts as a spectral filter on the gradient stream. Inside Muon, this filtering must happen before orthogonalization. The polar factor preserves singular directions but replaces all singular values with ones, so when it acts directly on a noisy gradient it erases the amplitude gap between signal and noise directions, and we shall never distinguish signal and noise even after undergoing the subsequent momentum. When momentum acts first, it filters the gradient stream to preserve the persistent signal component and attenuate the perturbation, so the polar factor operates on a matrix whose singular-value structure already separates signal from noise. The guiding principle is simple:先去噪，再正交denoise first, then orthogonalize.

To do so, we use the固定探头stationary probe通过收集by collectingKK在保存的检查点上进行小批量梯度，所有模型权重保持固定，并按集合顺序将动量管道应用到梯度缓冲区。 保持权重固定可以消除参数更新引起的非平稳性，因此探针隔离了实际训练检查点周围的随机梯度流。 在这种受控设置中，相干信号是一个明确定义的、时不变的目标，就像在程式化模型中一样。 同时，与程式化模型不同，梯度是由真实的学习任务生成的，因此保留了实际神经网络训练问题的结构。 在这里，我们在注意力输出投影层上的训练步骤 3000（总共 5100 个步骤）中使用 NanoGPT 固定探针。完整的设置出现在mini-batch gradients on a saved checkpoint with all model weights held fixed, and applying the momentum pipelines to the gradient buffer in collection order. Holding the weights fixed removes the non-stationarity caused by parameter updates, so the probe isolates the stochastic gradient stream around a realistic training checkpoint. In this controlled setting, the coherent signal is a well-defined, time-invariant target, just as in the stylized model. At the same time, unlike the stylized model, the gradients are generated by a real learning task and therefore retain the structure of an actual neural-network training problem. Here, we use the NanoGPT stationary probe at training step 3000 (out of 5100 total steps) on the attention output projection layers. The full settings appear inAppendix˜F，使用合成的 CIFAR-10 和额外的 NanoGPT 层和检查点结果, with synthetic, CIFAR-10, and additional NanoGPT layer and checkpoint results inAppendix˜G.

6 结论Conclusion

本文解释了为什么 Muon 正交化动量而不是原始梯度：动量充当谱滤波器，保留相干信号，同时衰减有界方差零均值正交扰动，因此极坐标步在信号奇异子空间已经稳定的缓冲区上运行。直接正交化，或者在平均之前对每个梯度进行正交化，会消除这种结构，并且在预期信号对齐方面可能会更差。同样的机制提出了一个超越 Muon 的设计规则：在任何以非线性频谱步骤结束的矩阵感知优化器中，将信号与噪声分离的频谱滤波器应该首先出现 -This paper explains why Muon orthogonalizes momentum rather than the raw gradient: momentum acts as a spectral filter that preserves the coherent signal while attenuating the bounded variance zero-mean orthogonal perturbation, so the polar step operates on a buffer in which the signal singular subspaces are already stabilized. Direct orthogonalization, or orthogonalizing each gradient before averaging, erases this structure and is provably worse in expected signal alignment. The same mechanism suggests a design rule that extends beyond Muon: in any matrix-aware optimizer that ends in a nonlinear spectral step, the spectral filter that separates signal from noise should come first —先去噪，再正交denoise first, then orthogonalize.

局限性和未来的工作。Limitations and future work.

有几个扩展处于开放状态。首先，实际的 Muon 训练通常会在早期训练期间增加动量系数，从而扩大迭代过程中的有效窗口大小。将这个依赖于时间表的故事形式化需要时变过滤分析。第二，Several extensions are left open. First, practical Muon training often increases the momentum coefficient during early training, which enlarges the effective window size across iterations. Formalizing this schedule-dependent story requires a time-varying filter analysis. Second,Theorem˜3在 1 阶尖峰高斯模型下得到证明。将其延伸至一般等级——is proved under the rank-1 spiked Gaussian model. Extending it to general rank-rr相干信号或非高斯扰动将需要更清晰的极性因子集中工具。除了这些扩展之外，谱隙机制还可以指导具有自适应动量更新的 Muon 变体的设计。coherent signals or to non-Gaussian perturbations would require sharper concentration tools for the polar factor. Beyond these extensions, the spectral-gap mechanism may also guide the design of Muon variants with adaptive momentum updates.

基于矩阵和基于 LMO 的优化器。Matrix-based and LMO-based optimizers.

基于矩阵的优化器已经超越了经典的坐标方式方法。受限玻尔兹曼机和深度网络中光谱下降的早期先驱包括Matrix-based optimizer has moved beyond classical coordinate-wise methods. Shampoo[20]和肥皂and SOAP[56]使用矩阵感知预处理，而 Scionuse matrix-aware preconditioning, while Scion[37]和胶子and Gluon[42]是基于 LMO 的方法，在范数约束的矩阵几何中运行。介子are LMO-based methods that operate in norm-constrained matrix geometry. Pion[45]使用双面正交变换设计基于矩阵的频谱保留优化器。并行工作研究 Muon 正交化步骤的实际改进，包括计算具有最佳最坏情况收敛的极分解的极表达uses double-sided orthogonal transformation to design a matrix-based spectrum-preserving optimizer. A parallel line of work studies practical refinements of Muon’s orthogonalization step, including the polar express that computes polar decomposition with optimal worst-case convergence[1], 低阶正交化, low-rank orthogonalization[22], 分块正交化, block-wise orthogonalization[4]和行动量归一化预处理, and row-momentum normalized preconditioning[14].

μ子理论和光谱更新。Theory of Muon and spectral updates.

最近的研究已经开始为 Muon 优化器和光谱更新提供理论基础。一行将 Muon 和相关正交化更新放置在范数约束几何中：Recent studies have started to provide a theoretical foundation for the Muon optimizer and spectral updates. One line places Muon and related orthogonalization updates in norm-constrained geometry:Chen et al. [9]将 Muon 视为核范数 Lion-K 优化器，其解耦权重衰减隐式对权重强制实施谱范数约束；view Muon as a nuclear-norm Lion-K optimizer whose decoupled weight decay implicitly enforces spectral-norm constraints on the weights;Kovalev [27]发展了梯度正交化及其动量变体的非欧几里得信赖域解释；和develops a non-Euclidean trust-region interpretation of gradient orthogonalization and its momentum variant; andShulgin et al. [46]将 Muon 作为一种不精确的 LMO 方法进行分析，量化牛顿-舒尔茨近似误差如何与步长和动量系数耦合。第二行研究谱下降和 Muon 的隐式偏差，证明多类可分离数据上谱范数最大裕度解的收敛性analyze Muon as an inexact LMO method, quantifying how Newton–Schulz approximation error couples with the step size and momentum coefficient. A second line studies the implicit bias of spectral descent and Muon, proving convergence to spectral-norm max-margin solutions on multiclass separable data[15]。第三行询问频谱正交化何时应改进优化，建立矩阵分解和上下文线性变换器中的预处理优势. A third line asks when spectral orthogonalization should improve optimization, establishing preconditioning benefits in matrix factorization and in-context linear transformers[33]，光谱均匀化或正交化最佳的各向同性曲率条件, isotropic-curvature conditions under which spectrum homogenization or orthogonalization is optimal[50]，以及稳定秩/核秩条件预测谱更新何时优于欧几里德梯度步骤, and stable-rank/nuclear-rank conditions predicting when spectral updates outperform Euclidean gradient steps[12]。第四行分析了每个组件差异可见的结构化任务：μ子型频谱更新平衡了关联记忆频率和存储容量的学习. A fourth line analyzes structured tasks where per-component disparities are visible: Muon-type spectral updates balance learning across associative-memory frequencies and storage capacity[28, 25], 重尾类分布, heavy-tailed class distributions[58], 主成分不平衡, imbalanced principal components[54]，以及相位检索中的各向异性曲率, and anisotropic curvature in phase retrieval[5]。此外，最近的一项研究线. Additionally, a recent research line[31, 39, 40, 45]研究频谱保存如何作为设计优化器的指导原则。这些工作共同从互补的角度阐明了光谱更新几何、隐式偏差和任务级缩放行为。studies how spectrum preservation can serve as a guiding principle to design optimizers. Together, these works clarify spectral-update geometry, implicit bias, and task-level scaling behavior from complementary angles.

动量算法研究进展.Research progress on the momentum algorithm.

动量是优化中分析最广泛的原语之一，理论研究沿着几个互补的方面进行组织。在经典的确定性优化中，Momentum is among the most extensively analyzed primitives in optimization, with theoretical study organized along several complementary aspects. In classical deterministic optimization,Polyak [38]显示重球在光滑的强凸二次方程上实现了加速线性速率，并通过几何和谱阐述show heavy-ball achieves an accelerated linear rate on smooth strongly convex quadratics, with a geometric and spectral exposition byGoh [19]。 Nesterov的加速梯度法达到最优. Nesterov’s accelerated gradient method attains the optimalO​(1/k2)O(1/k^{2})光滑凸物镜的速率rate for smooth convex objectives[35]。后来，. Later,Sutskever et al. [51]将这些方案扩展到深度网络训练。在随机优化中，extend these schemes to deep network training. In stochastic optimization,Cutkosky and Mehta [11]证明动量消除了标准化 SGD 的大批量要求，并且prove that momentum eliminates the large-batch requirement of normalized SGD, andDefazio [13]将动量重新表述为 SGD 作为原始平均，以获得更尖锐的非凸收敛边界。受信号处理理论的启发，reformulates SGD with momentum as primal averaging to obtain sharper non-convex convergence bounds. Inspired by signal processing theory,Li et al. [29]将频域中的动量解释为低通滤波器，放大低频梯度分量并衰减高频分量，高频抑制在后期训练中变得更加重要。这些作品共同从确定性加速、随机收敛和信号处理角度检验了动量。interpret momentum in the frequency domain as a low-pass filter that amplifies low-frequency gradient components and attenuates high-frequency components, with high-frequency suppression becoming more important in late training. Together, these works examine momentum from deterministic-acceleration, stochastic-convergence, and signal-processing angles.

深度学习中的梯度和噪声结构。Gradient and noise structure in deep learning.

了解神经网络训练过程中梯度和梯度噪声的经验结构一直是现代学习理论的核心关注点。在梯度方面，过参数化网络的 Hessian 谱通常会分成接近零的块和一些异常值，并且梯度可能会很大程度上集中在相应的顶部特征空间中Understanding the empirical structure of gradients and gradient noise during neural-network training has been a central concern of modern learning theory. On the gradient side, the Hessian spectrum of an overparametrized network often separates into a near-zero bulk and a few outliers, and the gradient can become largely concentrated in the corresponding top eigenspaces[43, 17]。这与梯度下降通常主要在由顶部 Hessian 特征向量跨越的小子空间内进行的观察结果一致. This is consistent with the observation that gradient descent often proceeds mostly within a small subspace spanned by the top Hessian eigenvectors[21]。在高维特征学习机制中，第一层权重的第一次梯度更新可以包含与目标信号对齐的Rank-1尖峰. In high-dimensional feature-learning regimes, the first gradient update of the first-layer weights can contain a rank-1 spike aligned with the target signal[2]。相关地，在结构化输入分布（例如尖峰协方差模型或多索引教师模型）下，基于梯度的训练可以利用隐藏的低维结构并将学习的表示驱动到相应的信号子空间. Relatedly, under structured input distributions such as spiked covariance models or multiple-index teacher models, gradient-based training can exploit the hidden low-dimensional structure and drive the learned representation toward the corresponding signal subspace[34]。在噪声方面，实证研究表明小批量梯度噪声可能是高度非高斯和重尾的. On the noise side, empirical studies suggest that mini-batch gradient noise can be highly non-Gaussian and heavy-tailed[47]。正交，SGD 噪声已被证明是各向异性的，其协方差与 Hessian 一致，有助于逃离尖锐的极小值. Orthogonally, SGD noise has been shown to be anisotropic, with its covariance aligned with the Hessian in a way that facilitates escape from sharp minima[61]。这些线程共同建立了现代深度学习训练中的梯度和噪声结构。. Together, these threads establish that gradient and noise structure in modern deep learning training.

本文的实验在两个硬件环境上运行。端到端 NanoGPT 和 LLaMA 350MThe experiments in this paper run on two hardware environments. The end-to-end NanoGPT and LLaMA 350M[52]训练比较报告于training comparison reported infigure˜1（前极性、后极性和仅极性）在 NVIDIA L40S GPU 上运行。所有剩余实验、合成模拟、CIFAR-10 固定和轨迹探测器以及 NanoGPT 固定和轨迹探测器均在 Wisteria Aquarius 上的 NVIDIA A100 40GB GPU 上运行(Pre-polar, Post-polar, and Polar-only) runs on NVIDIA L40S GPUs. All remaining experiments, the synthetic simulations, the CIFAR-10 stationary and trajectory probes, and the NanoGPT stationary and trajectory probes, run on NVIDIA A100 40GB GPUs on the Wisteria Aquarius111https://www.cc.u-tokyo.ac.jp/supercomputer/wisteria/service/东京大学的系统。system at the University of Tokyo.

L40S 实验分为两个端到端运行：在单节点、4-GPU PyTorch DDP 设置上进行 NanoGPT 三管道比较The L40S experiments split into two end-to-end runs: a NanoGPT three-pipeline comparison on a single-node, 4-GPU PyTorch DDP setup withbfloat16自动施放（autocast (Section˜F.4.4），以及在单节点、8-GPU PyTorch DDP 设置上进行的 LLaMA 350M 三管道比较), and a LLaMA 350M three-pipeline comparison on a single-node, 8-GPU PyTorch DDP setup withbfloat16训练（training (Section˜F.4.5）。对于 NanoGPT 实验，我们使用 GPT-2 式 12 层 / width-768 / 6-head modded-NanoGPT). For the NanoGPT experiment, we use a GPT-2-style 12-layer / width-768 / 6-head modded-NanoGPT222https://github.com/KellerJordan/modded-nanogpt在 FineWeb-10B 上训练的 speedrun 模型speedrun model trained on FineWeb-10B[36]。对于 LLaMA 实验，我们使用了缩小规模的语言模型，保留了相应的设计选择：LLaMA 风格的 24 层/宽度 1024/16 头因果模型，带有在 C4 上训练的 32k LLaMA 系列分词器. For the LLaMA experiment, we used a reduced-scale language model that preserves the corresponding design choices: a LLaMA-style 24-layer / width-1024 / 16-head causal model with a 32k LLaMA-family tokenizer trained on C4[41]。两项研究的共享 L40S 设置记录在. The shared L40S settings for the two studies are recorded inSections˜F.4.4和andF.4.5，并且每个 Muon 管道的最佳超参数选择在同一附录中报告。, and the best hyperparameter selections for each Muon pipeline are reported in the same appendices.

Wisteria 运行共享一个公共计算环境。综合模拟使用单个 A100 GPU 进行尖峰模型模拟。 CIFAR-10 固定和轨迹探头使用单个 A100。 NanoGPT 探测作业在 PyTorch DDP 下使用四个 A100The Wisteria runs share a common compute environment. The synthetic simulation uses a single A100 GPU for its spiked-model simulations. The CIFAR-10 stationary and trajectory probes use a single A100. The NanoGPT probe jobs use four A100s under PyTorch DDP withbfloat16混合精度。频谱摘要、极性因子、信号和子空间对齐均通过精确计算mixed precision. Spectrum summaries, polar factors, signal and subspace alignments are computed with exact浮动32float32SVD 内SVDs inside the分析程序Analysis procedure，当训练运行时, while training runs inbfloat16. CIFAR-10 和 NanoGPT 实验在指定的目标权重矩阵上使用相同的两个探针协议The CIFAR-10 and NanoGPT experiments use the same two probe protocols on a designated target weight matrixW∈ℝm×nW\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}。这两个协议的区别仅在于如何收集每步小批量梯度。下游. Gradients are collected immediately after backpropagation and before any optimizer state update is applied. We used two distinct momentum coefficients throughout:βtrain\beta_{\mathrm{train}}是训练时 Muon 动量系数（由优化器使用，生成is the training-time Muon momentum coefficient (used by the optimizer that generates{Gt}\{G_{t}\}），以及), andβ\beta是下面的探针分析应用于梯度缓冲区的探针侧动量系数。两者通过构造分离：is the probe-side momentum coefficient that the probe analysis below applies to the gradient buffer. The two are decoupled by construction: the分析程序Analysis procedure仅对收集的原始梯度缓冲区进行操作operates solely on the collected raw gradient buffer{Gt}\{G_{t}\}并且从不访问训练优化器的内部状态；在每个探测步骤中，三个管道都会从相同的梯度缓冲区重新计算and never accesses the training optimizer’s internal state; at every probe step the three pipelines are recomputed from the same gradient buffer{Gt}\{G_{t}\}。因此，前极坐标、后极坐标和仅极坐标比较是对公共梯度流的公平比较，并且训练时优化器设置仅通过生成的轨迹影响结果. Pre-polar, Post-polar, and Polar-only comparisons are therefore fair comparisons on a common gradient stream, and training-time optimizer settings affect the results only through the trajectory that generates{Gt}\{G_{t}\}。接下来，我们介绍静止探针和轨迹探针。. F.4.3 纳米GPT探针NanoGPT Probe

NanoGPT 训练代码改编自 modded-NanoGPT。所有 NanoGPT 探针运行、跨三个代表性注意力层的固定探针、以及跨每个注意力和 MLP 输出投影的轨迹探针，共享单个训练配置，如下所述，但 L40S 端到端运行配置除外The NanoGPT training code is adapted from modded-NanoGPT. All NanoGPT probe runs, the stationary probe across three representative attention layers, and the trajectory probe across every attention and MLP output projection, share a single training configuration, described below, except for the L40S end-to-end run configuration shown inSection˜F.4.4分别。separately.

本附录以固定动量系数扫描三个数据源的信噪比This appendix sweeps the signal-to-noise ratio across three data sources at fixed momentum coefficientβ=0.95\beta=0.95（完整设置在(full settings inSection˜F.5）。合成的). Syntheticλ\lambda直接充当主导信号奇异值。在 CIFAR-10 和 NanoGPT 上，我们使用小批量大小作为 SNR 的代理：在固定检查点，随机小批量梯度是全批量梯度的无偏估计，其采样噪声随着小批量大小的增加而减小。因此，增加小批量大小可以降低每步梯度噪声并提高有效梯度 SNRacts directly as the leading signal singular value. On CIFAR-10 and NanoGPT, we use the mini-batch size as a proxy for SNR: at a fixed checkpoint, the stochastic mini-batch gradient is an unbiased estimator of the full-batch gradient, and its sampling noise decreases as the mini-batch size increases. Thus, increasing the mini-batch size lowers the per-step gradient noise and raises the effective gradient SNR[48]。所有面板均遵循以下曲线、标记和参考约定.
